name: budget_web_app
description: A web app that allows me to track my spending including ai advisory support

paragraphs: Wealth is a personal finance web app that turns plain-English descriptions of your spending into a real, saved budget. It combines transaction tracking, budget monitoring, automated email reports, and an AI money coach ("Savvy Sal") that does all of its arithmetic through a sandboxed calculator and can record transactions and budgets directly to your account.
Built with Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Prisma/PostgreSQL, Better Auth, OpenAI, Inngest, Resend, and Arcjet.
features: Google OAuth sign-in/sign-up via Better Auth (no passwords stored).
Sessions persisted in PostgreSQL (sessions table) with secure, prefixed cookies.
that redirects unauthenticated users to /sign-in?redirect=... and returns them to the page they wanted after login.
User menu with avatar/initials, name, email, and sign-out.
